name: Empirical Bayes Covariance Decomposition
model_likelihood: X = Z L^T + E; Z^T Z = I_K; iid Gaussian noise with precision tau
prior: Independent loading entries with column-specific estimated priors g_k in G; EBCD-pl uses point-Laplace priors
inference_algorithm: Marginal-likelihood empirical Bayes via ELBO block updates: EBNM, polar rotation, precision update
estimand: Posterior mean loadings and their Gram/covariance decomposition
data_input: Data matrix X, or matched Gram factor C plus original sample count N
tunable_settings: Prespecified prior family G; user-specified K or greedy zero-factor stopping; initialization

name: Empirical Bayes Normal Means
model_likelihood: Independent normal observations x_p with latent means eta_p and known common variance s^2
prior: iid latent means eta_p ~ g in prespecified family G
inference_algorithm: Estimate g by marginal likelihood, equivalently ELBO optimization over g and unrestricted q
estimand: Estimated prior and posterior distribution of latent means
data_input: Normal-means observation vector x and known sampling variance s^2
